title: Enhanced Wear Resistance of Fine-Grained Ni-Based Coating via Annealing-Induced Phase Transformation
authors: Muhammad Arslan Hafeez, He Jp, C L Zhang, Lu Liu
abstract: Abstract Annealing is widely applied to reduce porosity and enhance the wear resistance of thermally sprayed metallic coatings; however, its effectiveness is often limited by grain coarsening and brittle phase formation. Here, we present a new approach that directly overcomes these limitations by coupling thermal spraying with the crystallization behavior of a rationally designed amorphous alloy powder (Ni 68.6 Cr 8.7 Nb 3 P 16 B 3.2 Si 0.5 ). Upon annealing at 800°C for 1 h, the metastable Mg 6 Cu 17 Si 7 -type phase present in the as-sprayed coating transforms into a well-refined three-phase microstructure, comprising a ductile Ni-based solid solution and hard Ni 3 P and NbNi 3 intermetallic phases, with 51% reduced intersplat density. This microstructural configuration results in a 21% reduction in COF and an 89% reduction in wear rate. The worn surface of annealed coating demonstrates minor thin grooves, lower fractions of oxides, and no sign of spallation, delamination or cracking, presenting a significant improvement in the wear resistance after annealing. This improvement originates from the three-phase composite microstructure in which the ductile Ni-based solid solution provides plastic deformability and crack resistance, whereas the hard Ni 3 P and NbNi 3 phases provide hardness and load-bearing capacity. Annealed coating exhibits mild abrasive wear mechanism coupled with limited plastic deformation. These findings demonstrate that controlled crystallization of thermally-sprayed coatings can be used to engineer beneficial phases, providing a promising strategy for the design of high-performance wear-resistant coatings.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Controlled crystallization offers a route to wear-resistant coatings that combine ductile crack resistance with hard, load-bearing intermetallic phases.

Anneal at 800°C for 1 h to transform the metastable phase into Ni-based solid solution, Ni₃P, and NbNi₃.
Evaluate microstructure, friction, wear rate, and worn-surface damage.

zh-Hans.title: 通过退火诱导相变提高细晶Ni基涂层的耐磨性
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 退火广泛用于降低热喷涂金属涂层的孔隙率并提高其耐磨性；然而，其效果往往受到晶粒粗化和脆性相形成的限制。本研究提出了一种新方法，将热喷涂与经过合理设计的非晶合金粉末（Ni 68.6 Cr 8.7 Nb 3 P 16 B 3.2 Si 0.5）的晶化行为相结合，直接克服这些限制。在800°C下退火1 h后，喷涂态涂层中存在的亚稳态Mg₆Cu₁₇Si₇型相转变为细化的三相显微组织，由具有延性的Ni基固溶体以及硬质Ni₃P和NbNi₃金属间化合物相组成，同时层片间界面密度降低了51%。这种显微组织使摩擦系数（COF）降低了21%，磨损率降低了89%。退火后涂层的磨损表面仅呈现轻微的细沟槽，氧化物占比更低，且未出现剥落、分层或开裂迹象，表明退火后耐磨性显著提高。这一改善源于三相复合显微组织：具有延性的Ni基固溶体提供塑性变形能力和抗裂性，而硬质Ni₃P和NbNi₃相提供硬度和承载能力。退火后涂层表现出轻微磨粒磨损机制，并伴有有限的塑性变形。这些发现表明，可以通过热喷涂涂层的可控晶化来构建有益相，为高性能耐磨涂层的设计提供了一种有前景的策略。

infographic.key_insight: 将热喷涂Ni基涂层在800°C下退火1 h，形成了细化的三相显微组织，并使磨损率降低了89%。

在800°C下退火1 h，使亚稳相转变为Ni基固溶体、Ni₃P和NbNi₃。
评估显微组织、摩擦、磨损率及磨损表面损伤。
infographic.evidence_signal: 相较于喷涂态涂层，退火使层片间界面密度降低了51%，摩擦系数降低了21%，磨损率降低了89%，且未观察到磨损表面发生剥落、分层或开裂。

title: Exploration of friction stir welding butted thin sheet NiTi with AA6061, AA2024, and AA7075
authors: Brayden Terry, A. Strauss
abstract: Friction stir welding was investigated as a method for producing dissimilar butt joints of 1-mm-thick NiTi sheet with three aluminum alloys: AA6061-T6, AA2024-T3, and AA7075-T6. Dissimilar welding of these materials could enable structural integration of shape memory alloys with common aerospace aluminum alloys, but differences in thermal and mechanical behavior make joining difficult. Joining NiTi and AA6061 was successful, while NiTi and AA2024 showed mixed results under tested conditions. NiTi and AA7075 did not join under tested conditions. Difficulty in joining AA2024 and AA7075 came from post-weld cracking attributed to residual stresses and thermal strain due to mismatch in coefficients of thermal expansion combined with lower ductility in the higher-strength aluminum alloys. Tensile testing showed that AA6061–NiTi welds retained moderate strength, with an average ultimate tensile strength of 167.8 MPa and a weld efficiency of 57.9% relative to AA6061-T6, while AA2024–NiTi welds showed lower strength and ductility, with an average tensile strength of 120 MPa and a weld efficiency of 27.6%. Fracture behavior suggests that failure was controlled by the ability of the interface to bear load across the joint. Microscopy revealed a region of dispersed NiTi particles in both AA6061 and AA2024 stir zones. Larger particles showed evidence of aluminum diffusion, while smaller particles were enriched in either Ni or Ti, consistent with formation of Ni-Al and Ti-Al intermetallic compounds. No intermetallic layer was observed on the micron scale at the weld interfaces for either AA6061 or AA2024. These results demonstrate that FSW can produce dissimilar Al alloy–NiTi joints, but mechanical performance is variable with alloy selection.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The process could integrate shape memory NiTi with aerospace aluminum structures, but alloy selection strongly affects joint integrity and strength.

Evaluate joint strength and ductility through tensile testing.

zh-Hans.title: NiTi薄板与AA6061、AA2024及AA7075搅拌摩擦对接焊探索
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了采用搅拌摩擦焊将1 mm厚NiTi薄板与三种铝合金（AA6061-T6、AA2024-T3和AA7075-T6）制成异种材料对接接头的方法。这些材料的异种焊接有望实现形状记忆合金与常用航空航天铝合金的结构集成，但其热学和力学行为差异使连接面临困难。NiTi与AA6061成功实现了连接，而NiTi与AA2024在所测试条件下的连接结果有成有败。NiTi与AA7075在所测试条件下未能实现连接。AA2024和AA7075的连接困难源于焊后开裂，这被归因于残余应力、热膨胀系数不匹配导致的热应变，以及较高强度铝合金较低的延性。拉伸试验表明，AA6061–NiTi焊接接头保持了中等强度，平均极限抗拉强度为167.8 MPa，相对于AA6061-T6的焊接效率为57.9%；而AA2024–NiTi焊接接头的强度和延性较低，平均抗拉强度为120 MPa，焊接效率为27.6%。断裂行为表明，失效受界面在接头两侧之间传递载荷的能力控制。显微观察显示，AA6061和AA2024的搅拌区内均存在NiTi颗粒弥散分布区域。较大颗粒显示出铝扩散的迹象，而较小颗粒则富集Ni或Ti，这与Ni-Al和Ti-Al金属间化合物的形成相一致。在AA6061和AA2024的焊接界面处，均未在微米尺度上观察到金属间化合物层。这些结果表明，搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）能够制备铝合金–NiTi异种材料接头，但其力学性能随合金选择而变化。

通过拉伸试验评估接头强度和延性。
采用显微观察检查界面和搅拌区的微观组织。
infographic.evidence_signal: AA6061–NiTi焊接接头的平均极限抗拉强度为167.8 MPa，焊接效率为57.9%；相比之下，AA2024–NiTi焊接接头的对应数值为120 MPa和27.6%。

title: A voltage signal analysis method for the welding process using the rice frequency
authors: Marek Fidali
abstract: This paper investigates the Rice frequency f R , defined as the square root of the ratio of the second to the zeroth spectral moment, as a descriptor of arc voltage signals in gas metal arc (GMA) welding. Short-Time Rice Frequency Analysis (STRFA) was applied to signals recorded in 89 controlled welds, 80 of which were analysed after documented exclusions, covering a reference condition and eleven deliberately introduced process disturbances. The disturbed zones of every weld were annotated from the recorded process channels and from photographs of the specimens. This allowed the disturbed segments to be compared with undisturbed segments of the same weld, which removes the influence of differences between welding sessions. When all windows of whole welds were pooled and compared with the reference welds, the effects of local disturbances were diluted. Within welds, shielding gas interruption decreased the mean f R by 24.5% (5/5 welds), and a 16% increase in welding current increased it by 155% (7/7 welds). The Rice frequency decreased monotonically with root gap (Spearman ρ = −0.90), groove angle (ρ = −0.76) and bevel hole diameter (ρ = −0.59), whereas travel speed and localised oil contamination had no consistent effect. The direction of the response reversed between window widths of about 10 and 50 ms. Long windows reflect the metal transfer frequency, while short windows reflect fast arc voltage fluctuations. The Rice frequency is therefore a computationally inexpensive, two-scale descriptor suitable for online welding monitoring, best used together with other signal features.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.engineering_relevance: Short-Time Rice Frequency Analysis could support online GMA welding monitoring when combined with other signal features.

Apply sliding-window analysis to arc voltage signals at different time scales.
Compare annotated disturbed and undisturbed segments within each weld to reduce session effects.

zh-Hans.title: 一种利用Rice频率分析焊接过程电压信号的方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文研究了Rice频率f R作为熔化极气体保护电弧（GMA）焊接中电弧电压信号描述量的适用性，该频率定义为二阶谱矩与零阶谱矩之比的平方根。研究对89条在受控条件下焊制的焊缝所记录的信号应用了短时Rice频率分析（STRFA）；按照有记录的排除情况，最终分析了其中80条焊缝，涵盖一种参考工况和十一种人为引入的过程扰动。依据记录的过程通道数据和试样照片，对每条焊缝的扰动区域进行了标注。这使得同一条焊缝内的扰动段与无扰动段能够进行比较，从而消除不同焊接批次之间差异的影响。当汇总完整焊缝的所有时间窗并与参考焊缝进行比较时，局部扰动的影响被稀释。在同一焊缝内进行比较时，保护气体中断使平均f R降低了24.5%（5/5条焊缝），而焊接电流增加16%使其升高了155%（7/7条焊缝）。Rice频率随根部间隙（Spearman ρ = −0.90）、坡口角度（ρ = −0.76）和坡口孔径（ρ = −0.59）的增大而单调降低，而焊接速度和局部油污未表现出一致的影响。在约10 ms与50 ms的窗宽之间，响应方向发生反转。长时间窗反映金属过渡频率，而短时间窗反映快速的电弧电压波动。因此，Rice频率是一种计算成本低、适用于在线焊接监测的双尺度描述量，最好与其他信号特征结合使用。

infographic.key_insight: Rice频率为焊接电弧电压提供了一种计算成本低的双尺度描述量，其对扰动的响应方向在约10 ms与50 ms的窗宽之间发生反转。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 短时Rice频率分析与其他信号特征结合使用时，可为在线GMA焊接监测提供支持。
method: 计算Rice频率，即二阶谱矩与零阶谱矩之比的平方根。
在不同时间尺度上对电弧电压信号进行滑动窗口分析。
比较每条焊缝内已标注的扰动段与无扰动段，以减小焊接批次的影响。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combining physics-based simulation with neural networks identified an optimal tested HDPE friction stir welding condition of 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework supports process-window selection to reduce weld defects, thermal gradients and axial-force fluctuations in HDPE joining.
method: Develop a 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian model of temperature, force, material flow and defect formation.
Train two multilayer perceptron neural networks on experimental temperature and axial-force histories.
Use simulations and ANN predictions to map defective and defect-free welding conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experimental validation showed good agreement with CEL predictions, ANN R² values of 0.91–0.99, and a peak plunge-force reduction from 1600 N to approximately 1100 N with 60 °C preheating.
infographic.watch_item: Predictive performance is demonstrated within the tested parameter space; extrapolation to other welding conditions requires further validation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量的计算建模与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被认可为连接热塑性材料的一种有效技术。本研究综合采用计算建模和机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行预测，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，以模拟不同转速、焊接速度及底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。通过实验数据验证了CEL数值模型，其在孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应的预测方面与实验结果表现出良好的一致性。结果表明，底面预热可有效减小温度梯度并稳定垂直力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使下压峰值力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从70 °C（未预热）升至约100 °C，从而减缓厚度方向的温度梯度并稳定轴向力分布。同时，利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），以预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明其在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的准确性和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域的形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架能够快速生成工艺图，标示存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在所测试条件下，1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C预热为最优条件，而在1000 rpm且未预热时，由于形成虫洞缺陷，焊接性较差。这些发现为制备性能可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并展示了将计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW工艺的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中得到更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合基于物理的模拟与神经网络，确定了所测试条件下HDPE搅拌摩擦焊的最优工艺条件：1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C底部预热。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架支持焊接工艺窗口的选择，以减少HDPE连接中的焊接缺陷、温度梯度和轴向力波动。
method: 建立温度、力、材料流动和缺陷形成的三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模型。
利用实验温度和轴向力的时间历程数据训练两个多层感知机神经网络。
利用模拟和ANN预测，绘制存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接条件分布图。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验验证表明，CEL预测与实验结果具有良好的一致性，ANN的R²值为0.91–0.99，且60 °C预热使下压峰值力从1600 N降至约1100 N。
infographic.watch_item: 预测性能已在所测试的参数空间内得到验证；外推至其他焊接条件仍需进一步验证。

title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should match the dominant damage mechanism: NiCrAlY for hardness and chloride-corrosion resistance, or 80Ni20Cr for erosion resistance under the tested conditions.

zh-Hans.title: 面向结构应用的Al 6061-T6基体上爆炸喷涂80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在Al 6061-T6合金基体上沉积了80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、物相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性和抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量和冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与80Ni20Cr相比，NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD在80Ni20Cr中鉴定出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的CrNi相，在NiCrAlY中鉴定出具有正交晶体结构的Al₂NiY相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶粒结构。AFM测量表明，在全部三个样品中，NiCrAlY的表面粗糙度最低。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY的硬度约为80Ni20Cr的10倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY的硬度为7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），80Ni20Cr的硬度为780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆Al 6061基体的硬度为708.68 MPa。在3.5 wt% NaCl溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY的腐蚀电流密度最低，为6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr涂层的腐蚀电流密度为1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.01427 mmpy。两种涂层的腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY表现出超疏水性，80Ni20Cr表现出接近超疏水的特性。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的3.5 wt% NaCl溶液；冲击角度90°、速度40 m/s、持续时间5 min的单一冲蚀工况），NiCrAlY具有更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性能，而80Ni20Cr具有更好的抗冲蚀性能。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并非对长期服役寿命的预测。

title: EFFECT OF CEO2 AND LA2O3 REINFORCEMENTS ON MECHANICAL, TRIBOLOGICAL AND MICROSTRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF WC–12CO COATING BY HIGH-VELOCITY OXYGEN FUEL DEPOSITION TECHNIQUE
authors: Satyanarayan Dubey, Shyam Birla, Tribhuwan Kishore Mishra
abstract: Decarburization during HVOF deposition reduces the workability of Tungsten Carbide-12% Cobalt (WC-12Co) coatings. This work examines how CeO2 and La2O3 reinforcements affect HVOF-sprayed WC-12Co coatings' mechanical, tribological, and microstructural characteristics. Compared to the unreinforced coating, microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, abrasive wear, coefficient of friction, and microhardness were assessed. CeO2 or La2O3 decreased porosity and finer grain structure without affecting bond strength. Coatings with 1 wt.% CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively, compared to the unreinforced WC-12Co coating, which had an adhesive bond strength of 73.60 ± 5 MPa. Both changed coatings improved structural stability, grain refinement, and densification. Minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m was found in WC-12Co-1La2O3, whereas the lowest coefficient of friction was 0.4 in WC-12Co-1CeO2. An oxide layer from reinforcements enhanced wear resistance. SEM investigation of worn surfaces showed debris, dislodged carbide particles, SiC grains, microcracks, and grooves as the predominant wear processes.

infographic.key_insight: Adding 1 wt.% CeO2 or La2O3 to HVOF-sprayed WC–12Co refined the microstructure, reduced porosity, and improved hardness and wear performance without affecting bond strength.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Rare-earth oxide additions offer a route to denser, more wear-resistant WC–12Co coatings for abrasive-service components.
method: Deposit unreinforced and CeO2- or La2O3-reinforced WC–12Co coatings using HVOF spraying.
Compare microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, microhardness, abrasive wear, and friction.
Examine worn surfaces by SEM to identify wear mechanisms.

zh-Hans.title: CeO2和La2O3增强相对采用超音速火焰喷涂技术沉积的WC–12Co涂层力学性能、摩擦学性能及微观组织的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）沉积过程中的脱碳会降低碳化钨-12%钴（WC-12Co）涂层的加工性能。本研究考察了CeO2和La2O3增强相对HVOF喷涂WC-12Co涂层力学性能、摩擦学性能及微观组织特征的影响。以未增强涂层为对照，评估了微观组织、物相组成、结合强度、磨粒磨损、摩擦系数和显微硬度。CeO2或La2O3降低了孔隙率并细化了晶粒，而未影响结合强度。与未增强的WC-12Co涂层相比，添加1 wt.% CeO2和La2O3的涂层显微硬度分别提高了6%和4%；未增强涂层的结合强度为73.60 ± 5 MPa。两种改性涂层的组织稳定性、晶粒细化程度和致密化程度均有所提高。WC-12Co-1La2O3的磨损率最低，为3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m，而WC-12Co-1CeO2的摩擦系数最低，为0.4。增强相形成的氧化物层提高了耐磨性。对磨损表面的扫描电子显微镜（SEM）观察显示，主要磨损过程涉及磨屑、脱落的碳化物颗粒、SiC磨粒、微裂纹和犁沟。

infographic.key_insight: 向HVOF喷涂的WC–12Co中添加1 wt.% CeO2或La2O3可细化微观组织、降低孔隙率，并提高硬度和耐磨性能，同时不影响结合强度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 添加稀土氧化物为磨粒磨损工况下使用的部件制备更致密、更耐磨的WC–12Co涂层提供了一条途径。
method: 采用HVOF喷涂技术沉积未增强及CeO2或La2O3增强的WC–12Co涂层。
比较微观组织、物相组成、结合强度、显微硬度、磨粒磨损和摩擦性能。
利用SEM观察磨损表面，以识别磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: 添加量为1 wt.%时，CeO2和La2O3使显微硬度分别提高了6%和4%；添加La2O3时磨损率最低，为3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，而添加CeO2时摩擦系数最低，为0.4。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr combined the lowest measured wear rate with the best corrosion resistance, while HVOF achieved the highest hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel, HVAF is a promising process choice when both wear and corrosion resistance are priorities.
method: Deposited WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation spraying, HVOF, and HVAF.

Examined wear tracks to identify abrasive and fatigue wear mechanisms.
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF reduced volume wear rate from (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ for bare steel to (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m) and showed the lowest corrosion current density among coatings, (1.75±0.02) µA/cm².

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速氧燃料喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性及耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能及耐腐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更佳。耐腐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 VSCE)、最小的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。APS涂层在这四种涂层中的耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: HVAF喷涂的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层兼具最低的实测磨损率和最佳的耐腐蚀性，而HVOF涂层具有最高的硬度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于304不锈钢上的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层，当耐磨性和耐腐蚀性均为优先考虑因素时，HVAF是一种有前景的工艺选择。
method: 采用APS、爆炸喷涂、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上沉积WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较微观组织、维氏硬度、摩擦性能、磨损率和腐蚀行为。
观察磨痕，以识别磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF使体积磨损率从未涂覆不锈钢的(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)降至(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，且其腐蚀电流密度为所有涂层中最低，为(1.75±0.02) µA/cm²。

title: Lean maintenance 4.0: Enhancing welding machine reliability in steel galvanizing processes
authors: Lucas Matos, Nuno Torre Torre, Andrei Bonamigo
abstract: Maintenance is a critical function in the steel industry, playing a key role in production performance. Lean methodologies are extensively implemented in industrial settings, emphasizing practices that drive continuous improvement. Industry 4.0 has emerged through intelligent technologies designed to digitalize industrial processes. The combination of these approaches creates meaningful synergies that can assist both researchers and practitioners in enhancing the operational efficiency of organizational assets. The objective of this study is to investigate how Lean 4.0 principles can enhance maintenance management and operational efficiency in a welding machine within a steel galvanizing process. This research applies Lean 4.0 principles through an empirical case study of a welding machine in a steel galvanizing line, focusing on ensuring welding quality and optimizing maintenance processes. The findings reveal a considerable reduction in production downtime: by standardizing disc replacement procedures, introducing a machine checklist, and providing staff training, the continuous galvanizing line achieved a reduction of 375 minutes per year in total welding machine downtime, compared to the historical baseline of 496 minutes per year specifically associated with welding disk failures. This optimization resulted in organizational improvements and a more competitive industrial environment with skilled personnel.
venue: International Journal of Industrial Engineering and Management

infographic.key_insight: Lean 4.0 maintenance practices reduced welding-machine downtime in a steel galvanizing line by a reported 375 minutes per year.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Standardized maintenance and operator training can improve welding-machine reliability and support continuous galvanizing operations.
method: Empirical case study of a welding machine in a continuous galvanizing line.

zh-Hans.title: 精益维护4.0：提升钢材镀锌工艺中焊机的可靠性
zh-Hans.abstract: 维护是钢铁行业的一项关键职能，对生产绩效起着重要作用。精益方法在工业环境中得到广泛应用，强调推动持续改进的实践。工业4.0依托旨在实现工业过程数字化的智能技术而兴起。这些方法的结合产生了有意义的协同效应，可帮助研究人员和实践者提高组织资产的运行效率。本研究旨在探讨精益4.0原则如何改善钢材镀锌工艺中焊机的维护管理和运行效率。本研究通过对钢材镀锌生产线上一台焊机的实证案例研究，应用精益4.0原则，重点关注确保焊接质量和优化维护流程。研究结果表明，生产停机时间显著减少：通过规范焊接圆盘更换程序、引入设备检查清单并开展员工培训，该连续镀锌生产线的焊机总停机时间每年减少了375分钟，对照的历史基准为每年496分钟，该基准具体对应于焊接圆盘故障所致的停机时间。这一优化带来了组织层面的改进，并形成了人员技能熟练、竞争力更强的工业环境。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢的热膨胀系数极低，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形态演变及电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支撑。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大使反冲压力增大，从而增大熔深和小孔尺寸，强化熔池整体流动，且在高功率下电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，焊接速度提高使热输入降低，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，高速下电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大使电弧力增强，促进焊缝宽度增大并强化熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更加稳定。

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

zh-Hans.title: 通过基于物理的数字孪生降低用于太空金属连接的机器人焊接风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 随着人们对太空在轨服务、制造和装配的兴趣日益增长，用于模块化建造和在轨维修的可靠金属连接技术再次受到关注。机器人焊接具有应用前景，但对其在低重力和低压条件下的运行特性仍缺乏充分认识，且近似实际飞行条件的试验有限。由英国航天局（UK Space Agency）支持的 ISPARK 项目正在开发基于物理的数字孪生，以系统性地降低工艺风险。本文评估了一个基于模型的原型，该原型结合了有限体积焊接熔池热模型、高斯过程（GP）和神经网络代理模型，以及仿真六轴机械臂。简化模型包含固液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力参数。重力通过静水压力与毛细压力之比单独评估，不进入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八个输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出的边界工况中，80 个求解器响应有 74 个落在标称 90% 的 GP 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，包括数据缩放和预测方差计算。在一项仿真 UR5 沿 L 形焊缝运动的研究中，当行进速度在拐角附近下降时，比例控制器会调整一元化焊接电源的设定值。有限体积模型的重新评估表明，全部 12 个闭环工况点和 12 个开环工况点中的 9 个落在示例性的 1.0-3.0 mm 焊缝根部宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试前使用该框架筛选焊接工况和控制策略。仍需开展热真空试验、有针对性的低重力试验和机器人硬件在环研究，以评估模型和控制器。

infographic.key_insight: 结合焊接熔池仿真与高斯过程代理模型的物理基础数字孪生，有望用于在太空连接实验前筛选机器人焊接工况和控制策略。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 快速代理预测有望帮助根据机器人速度变化调整焊接设定，并减轻开发可靠在轨金属连接技术所需的实验负担。
method: 有限体积热模型包含相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力；重力单独评估。
采用重复五折交叉验证比较高斯过程和神经网络代理模型。
仿真 UR5 沿 L 形焊缝运动，同时通过比例控制调整焊接电源设定值。
infographic.evidence_signal: GP 在全部八个输出上均优于神经网络，其标称 90% 预测区间覆盖了 74/80 个留出的求解器响应；在仿真中，闭环工况点有 12/12 个满足示例性焊缝宽度范围，而开环工况点为 9/12 个。
infographic.watch_item: 结果仍基于仿真；需要开展热真空、低重力和机器人硬件在环测试，以评估模型和控制器的有效性。

title: Impact Of Co–Cr, Ni, and NiCr binder systems on the microstructure and functional properties of WC coatings produced by detonation spraying
authors: Zarina Aringozhina, Нуртолеу Магазов, Nazerke Muktanova, Gulzhaz Uazyrkhanova
abstract: This study investigates the influence of metallic binder composition (Co–Cr, Ni, and NiCr) on the microstructure and performance characteristics of tungsten carbide-based coatings deposited by detonation spraying. A comprehensive characterization was carried out using scanning electron microscopy, EDS elemental mapping, microhardness testing, tribological evaluation, scratch testing, and electrochemical corrosion analysis. The results demonstrate that binder type significantly affects coating porosity, WC phase distribution, hardness, and tribological behavior. The WC–Co-Cr coating exhibited the most favorable combination of properties: the lowest coefficient of friction (0.515), the highest microhardness (1232.55 HV), the best scratch resistance, and superior corrosion resistance in 3.5 wt.% NaCl solution. The WC–Ni coating showed the lowest porosity (0.40%) due to the high fluidity of the nickel binder, while WC–NiCr demonstrated the highest porosity (2.78%) and the most pronounced susceptibility to cracking under progressive loading. The findings confirm the strong potential of detonation-sprayed WC–Co-Cr coatings for extending the service life of pipeline valves and other components operating under wear and corrosion conditions in the oil and gas industry.

infographic.key_insight: Among the three detonation-sprayed WC coatings, WC–Co–Cr delivered the best overall hardness, friction, scratch resistance, and corrosion performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: WC–Co–Cr coatings are promising for pipeline valves and other oil-and-gas components exposed to combined wear and corrosion.

Characterized microstructure and composition using SEM and EDS mapping.

infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not establish long-term performance under representative valve service conditions, so application-specific validation is needed.

zh-Hans.title: Co–Cr、Ni和NiCr粘结相体系对爆炸喷涂WC涂层微观组织和功能性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究探讨了金属粘结相成分（Co–Cr、Ni和NiCr）对爆炸喷涂制备的碳化钨基涂层微观组织和性能特征的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜、EDS元素面分布分析、显微硬度测试、摩擦学评价、划痕测试和电化学腐蚀分析进行了全面表征。结果表明，粘结相类型显著影响涂层孔隙率、WC相分布、硬度和摩擦学行为。WC–Co-Cr涂层表现出最佳的综合性能：最低的摩擦系数（0.515）、最高的显微硬度（1232.55 HV）、最佳的抗划伤性能，以及在3.5 wt.% NaCl溶液中优异的耐腐蚀性能。由于镍粘结相具有较高的流动性，WC–Ni涂层的孔隙率最低（0.40%）；而WC–NiCr涂层的孔隙率最高（2.78%），且在渐增加载下表现出最明显的开裂倾向。研究结果证实，爆炸喷涂WC–Co-Cr涂层在延长石油和天然气行业中磨损与腐蚀工况下运行的管道阀门及其他部件的使用寿命方面具有巨大潜力。

infographic.key_insight: 在三种爆炸喷涂WC涂层中，WC–Co–Cr在硬度、摩擦、抗划伤和耐腐蚀方面表现出最佳的综合性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: WC–Co–Cr涂层有望用于承受磨损与腐蚀共同作用的管道阀门及其他石油和天然气行业部件。
method: 采用Co–Cr、Ni和NiCr粘结相，通过爆炸喷涂制备WC涂层。
采用SEM和EDS面分布分析表征微观组织和成分。
测定显微硬度、摩擦学行为、抗划伤性能和电化学腐蚀性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: WC–Co–Cr的显微硬度达到1232.55 HV，摩擦系数为0.515；WC–Ni的孔隙率最低（0.40%），WC–NiCr的孔隙率最高（2.78%）；腐蚀测试采用3.5 wt.% NaCl溶液。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未能确立涂层在代表性阀门服役条件下的长期性能，因此仍需针对具体应用进行验证。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Disk-like droplets with high circularity and expansion favor dense Fe-based amorphous coatings, while lower porosity improves long-term corrosion resistance and higher humidity reduces friction and wear.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Controlling detonation-spray parameters and accounting for service humidity can help tailor protective coatings for Q235 carbon steel.
method: Deposit Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 steel using varied detonation-spray parameters.
Examine droplet morphology, lamellar structure, and coating porosity.
Evaluate long-term corrosion and sliding wear under different humidity conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports poorer long-term corrosion resistance with greater porosity and decreasing friction coefficients and wear rates as humidity increases.
infographic.watch_item: The humidity-dependent wear findings involve Si3N4 counterface balls and may not transfer directly to other contact materials.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为及其在不同湿度环境下的磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢表面成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀与摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展系数，这对于减少涂层缺陷并形成具有致密微观组织的细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷越多，其长期耐腐蚀性越低。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层在不同湿度条件下的磨损行为具有重要作用。随着环境湿度升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 具有高圆度和高铺展系数的圆盘状液滴有利于形成致密的铁基非晶涂层，而较低的孔隙率可改善长期耐腐蚀性，较高的湿度则可降低摩擦和磨损。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制爆炸喷涂参数并考虑服役环境湿度，有助于为Q235碳钢定制防护涂层。
method: 采用不同爆炸喷涂参数，在Q235钢表面沉积铁基非晶涂层。
考察液滴形貌、层片结构和涂层孔隙率。
评估长期腐蚀行为以及不同湿度条件下的滑动磨损行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要指出，孔隙率越高，长期耐腐蚀性越差；随着湿度升高，摩擦系数和磨损率降低。
infographic.watch_item: 有关湿度依赖性磨损的研究结果涉及Si3N4对磨球，可能无法直接推广至其他接触材料。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio improved coating density, smoothness, and adhesion, while peak microhardness occurred at the intermediate ratio of 1.1.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Oxygen-to-acetylene ratio control offers a practical way to tailor flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si coatings on AISI 321 steel.

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层显微组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料，使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统通过火焰喷涂制备涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气与乙炔的比值（O₂/C₂H₂）分别调节为1.0、1.1和1.2。采用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数，并对所得涂层的显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行表征。随着O₂/C₂H₂比值增大，涂层组织趋于致密，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度则从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa升至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。在O₂/C₂H₂比值为1.1时，获得了最高的平均显微硬度，为1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层具有最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比值是调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层显微组织和力学特性的有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 增大O₂/C₂H₂比值可提高涂层的致密性、表面光滑度和结合强度，而显微硬度在中间比值1.1处达到峰值。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制氧气与乙炔的比值，为调控AISI 321钢上的火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si涂层提供了一种实用方法。
method: 使用Metal Coat 6PM-II火焰喷涂系统，在O₂/C₂H₂比值分别为1.0、1.1和1.2的条件下制备涂层。
使用Accuraspray 4.0监测喷涂参数。
评价显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 当比值从1.0增至1.2时，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%，粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa升至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa；在比值为1.1时，平均显微硬度达到峰值1051.7 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 这些研究结果仅涵盖AISI 321钢上的三种气体比值；摘要尚未证实其服役耐久性及对其他基体的适用性。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: Drilled-to-bossed geometry improved AA2024-T351 friction-weld joint strength, while an ensemble residual network predicted ultimate tensile strength with R² ≈ 0.81.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Geometry-assisted direct drive friction welding offers a promising route to stronger aluminium joints for lightweight aerospace and automotive structures.
method: Tested welding conditions using an L18 orthogonal experimental design on a customized engine lathe.
Varied friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying geometry, and friction time.
Compared ensemble residual, compact attention, and adaptive multiscale networks for tensile-strength prediction.
infographic.evidence_signal: The reported optimum—30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min friction time—achieved 538 MPa tensile strength and 325 MPa torsional strength.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify prediction-validation splits or independent testing, leaving model generalization beyond the studied conditions uncertain.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 采用孔—凸台配合几何构型与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 航空航天和汽车行业对轻质高强材料的需求日益增长，AA2024-T351等铝合金凭借出色的强度重量比而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中获得可靠接头仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究重点优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。研究引入了一种受传统榫卯接头启发的新型孔—凸台配合几何构型，以增强机械互锁并改善焊接接头的完整性。采用L18正交表系统设计试验，以评估抗拉强度和抗扭强度。试验在一台定制改装的普通车床上进行，选取摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何构型和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。同时，采用集成残差网络、紧凑型注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络等先进深度学习模型，根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，由30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、孔—凸台配合几何构型和4 min摩擦时间组成的最优参数组合产生了优异的力学性能，抗拉强度达到538 MPa，抗扭强度达到325 MPa。与传统平面—平面接头相比，孔—凸台配合构型的接头强度显著提高。此外，在所采用的深度学习模型中，集成残差网络的预测精度最高，R²约为0.81，有效捕捉了工艺参数与焊接接头强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.key_insight: 孔—凸台配合几何构型提高了AA2024-T351摩擦焊接头的强度，而集成残差网络对极限抗拉强度的预测达到R² ≈ 0.81。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 几何构型辅助的直接驱动摩擦焊为轻量化航空航天和汽车结构获得更高强度的铝合金接头提供了一条有前景的途径。
method: 在一台定制改装的普通车床上，采用L18正交试验设计测试焊接条件。
改变摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何构型和摩擦时间。
比较集成残差网络、紧凑型注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络在抗拉强度预测方面的表现。
infographic.evidence_signal: 所报告的最优条件——30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、孔—凸台配合几何构型和4 min摩擦时间——实现了538 MPa的抗拉强度和325 MPa的抗扭强度。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明用于预测与验证的数据划分方式，也未说明是否进行了独立测试，因此模型在所研究条件之外的泛化能力仍不确定。

title: Feedstock Morphology Governs Impact-Induced Deformation in Cold Sprayed Metal-Ceramic Composites
authors: Romario A. Wicaksono, Amir Ardeshiri Lordejani, Sara Bagherifard
abstract: The mechanistic understanding of cold spray additive manufacturing for metal-ceramic composites has mainly focused on spray parameters, whereas the role of metallic feedstock morphology remains comparatively underexplored. This study elucidates how spherical and spongy Cu morphologies govern impact-induced deformation, microstructural evolution, and the resulting structure-property relationship in Cu-Al 2 O 3 composite deposits. Multi-scale characterization, including microstructural analysis, nano- and micro-hardness measurements, micro-compression tests, and tribological analyses, reveals distinct strain patterns within the deposits that are influenced by particle morphology. Spherical Cu promotes interfacial strain localization and interfacial metal–ceramic contacts along flattened splats, giving rise to a distinct bimodal grain structure characterized by grain refinement at splat boundaries and larger, unrefined grains within splat cores. This microstructural gradient effectively balances strength and ductility. In contrast, the collapse of the spongy Cu ligament upon impact forms a volumetrically distributed strain-hardened zone, resulting in a more broadly distributed strain accumulation and enhanced ceramic encapsulation. The findings indicate that ceramic particles play an active role in influencing deformation caused by impact, while also passively strengthening the deposits. This dual function is directly reflected in the enhanced performance of the deposits, even at comparable reinforcement fraction. These findings demonstrate that, in addition to the spray parameters, the powder morphology serves as a fundamental governing factor in controlling the deformation mechanisms and deposit performance.

infographic.key_insight: Cu feedstock morphology governs impact deformation in cold-sprayed Cu–Al₂O₃ composites: spherical particles localize strain at splat interfaces, while spongy particles distribute strain through ligament collapse.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Powder morphology offers a design lever alongside spray parameters to tailor composite microstructure, ceramic encapsulation, and mechanical performance.
method: Compare deposits produced with spherical and spongy Cu feedstocks.
Characterize microstructure and nano- and micro-hardness.
Evaluate mechanical and wear behavior using micro-compression and tribological tests.
infographic.evidence_signal: Multi-scale characterization links spherical Cu to refined splat boundaries and coarser cores, and spongy Cu to distributed strain hardening and greater ceramic encapsulation, with performance differences even at comparable reinforcement fractions.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative performance gains or processing window, limiting assessment of effect size and transferability.
infographic.paper_title: Feedstock Morphology Governs Impact-Induced Deformation in Cold Sprayed Metal-Ceramic Composites

zh-Hans.title: 原料形貌主导冷喷涂金属-陶瓷复合材料中的冲击诱导变形
zh-Hans.abstract: 对金属-陶瓷复合材料冷喷涂增材制造机制的理解主要集中于喷涂参数，而金属原料形貌的作用相对缺乏研究。本研究阐明了球形和海绵状Cu形貌如何主导Cu-Al 2 O 3复合沉积体中的冲击诱导变形、微观组织演化及其形成的组织-性能关系。包括微观组织分析、纳米及显微硬度测量、微压缩试验和摩擦学分析在内的多尺度表征揭示了沉积体内部受颗粒形貌影响的不同应变分布模式。球形Cu促进应变在界面处局部化，并促进沿扁平化喷溅片形成金属-陶瓷界面接触，从而产生独特的双峰晶粒组织，其特征是喷溅片边界处晶粒细化，而喷溅片核心内部保留较大且未细化的晶粒。这种微观组织梯度有效平衡了强度与延性。相比之下，海绵状Cu的韧带结构在冲击时塌缩，形成在体积内分布的应变硬化区，使应变累积的分布更为广泛，并增强对陶瓷的包覆。研究结果表明，陶瓷颗粒在影响冲击引起的变形方面发挥主动作用，同时也被动地强化沉积体。这种双重功能直接体现在沉积体性能的提升上，即使在增强相含量相当时也是如此。这些发现表明，除喷涂参数外，粉末形貌也是控制变形机制和沉积体性能的根本性主导因素。

infographic.key_insight: Cu原料形貌主导冷喷涂Cu–Al₂O₃复合材料中的冲击变形：球形颗粒使应变局部化于喷溅片界面，而海绵状颗粒通过韧带结构塌缩使应变分散分布。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 除喷涂参数外，粉末形貌也可作为调控复合材料微观组织、陶瓷包覆及力学性能的设计手段。
method: 比较使用球形和海绵状Cu原料制备的沉积体。
表征微观组织以及纳米硬度和显微硬度。
通过微压缩和摩擦学试验评估力学行为与磨损行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 多尺度表征将球形Cu与喷溅片边界处的晶粒细化及核心处较粗大的晶粒联系起来，将海绵状Cu与分散分布的应变硬化及更充分的陶瓷包覆联系起来；即使增强相含量相当，沉积体仍表现出性能差异。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供定量的性能提升数据或工艺窗口，限制了对效应大小和可迁移性的评估。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting nozzle traverse speed and spray distance offers a route to controlling coating surface properties and maximizing hydrophobicity.
method: Evaluate coating surface properties under varied detonation-spraying conditions.
Relate roughness and thickness to nozzle traverse speed using inverse power laws.
Model roughness and contact angle versus spray distance using parabolic relationships.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports parameter-dependent relationships and optimal spraying conditions for maximum hydrophobicity, but provides no numerical results or validation metrics.
infographic.watch_item: Confirm model validity and optimal settings for the intended material system and equipment before transferring them to production.

zh-Hans.title: 不同工艺条件下爆炸喷涂制备的钛基涂层的表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文描述了二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的表面性能与爆炸喷涂条件之间的关系。研究发现，通过选择喷涂工艺参数的特定值，可在制备过程中控制表面粗糙度、表面厚度及疏水性等性能。研究确定了使所制备涂层疏水性达到最大的爆炸喷涂工艺参数最优值。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度随喷嘴移动速度的变化遵循反幂律。粗糙度和接触角随喷涂距离的变化遵循抛物线规律。研究获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，以及确定使涂层疏水性达到最佳的最优喷涂工况。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂参数可用于调控二氧化钛基涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 选择喷嘴移动速度和喷涂距离，为控制涂层表面性能并使疏水性最大化提供了一种途径。
method: 评估不同爆炸喷涂条件下的涂层表面性能。
利用反幂律建立粗糙度和厚度与喷嘴移动速度之间的关系。
利用抛物线关系建立粗糙度和接触角随喷涂距离变化的模型。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了随参数变化的关系，以及使疏水性达到最大的最优喷涂条件，但未提供数值结果或验证指标。
infographic.watch_item: 将模型和最优参数设置应用于生产前，应确认其对目标材料体系和设备的有效性。
